# Verbs by purpose

Browse implemented operations by what they do. Grammar verbs configure pipe stages; direct helpers take their data arguments immediately. A shared namespace does not make every function a verb factory.

[All public callables (A–Z)](a-z.md) · [Learn: verbs](../../learn/verbs.md)

[Transform](#transform) · [State and events](#state-and-events) · [Synchrony and comparison](#synchrony-and-comparison) · [Spatial and alignment](#spatial-and-alignment) · [Visualization](#visualization) · [Output and side effects](#output-and-side-effects) · [Other helpers](#other-helpers)

| [anomaly](anomaly.md) | Grammar verb / pipe stage | express values as departures from a mean |
